flow_overview: A music database and marketplace platform that supports contributor navigation to release submission guidance and related submission workflows.
capability_summary: Contributor help and submission guidance discovery
Navigation from account area to contribution resources
Structured overview of release submission rules
Access to detailed guideline topics for release metadata

requirements.text: The system shall preserve documentation context when contributors open detailed rule pages from the release submission overview, including a visible path back to the originating overview section.
requirements.rationale: The overview context is supported, but cross-page context preservation after opening a detailed rule page is not shown.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall help users continue from overview documentation into related articles when they need more detailed submission rules.

claims.claim: The release submission overview preserves documentation context.
claims.claim_text: The release submission overview preserves documentation context.

claims.claim: Detailed rule pages opened from the release submission overview preserve a path back to the originating overview section.
claims.claim_text: Detailed rule pages opened from the release submission overview preserve a path back to the originating overview section.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 3 shows the overview page with breadcrumb context, but the flow does not open a detailed rule page from the overview.

requirements.text: The system shall clearly distinguish which contribution resources are generally browsable and which submission work areas require an authenticated contributor account.
requirements.rationale: The related areas are visible, but the explicit access distinction required by the claim is not shown and partly depends on access policy.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall support discovery of contributor documentation from an authenticated user workspace.

claims.claim: Contribution resources and submission work areas are both present in the contribution experience.
claims.claim_text: Contribution resources and submission work areas are both present in the contribution experience.

claims.claim: The system clearly distinguishes generally browsable contribution resources from work areas requiring an authenticated contributor account.
claims.claim_text: The system clearly distinguishes generally browsable contribution resources from work areas requiring an authenticated contributor account.

requirements.evidence_note: Steps 1 and 2 show authenticated workspace areas and contribution resources, and step 3 shows documentation, but no visible labels explain which resources are public versus account-gated.

requirements.text: The system shall keep the release submission overview aligned with the currently applicable submission policy so contributors see up to date rules.
requirements.rationale: The central policy-alignment and freshness obligation is external to the visible flow, so a reliable fulfilled or not-fulfilled decision is not possible.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall provide a dedicated overview page that summarizes the rules and process for submitting releases.

claims.claim: The system presents a release submission overview with policy guidance.
claims.claim_text: The system presents a release submission overview with policy guidance.

claims.claim: The release submission overview is aligned with the currently applicable submission policy and remains up to date.
claims.claim_text: The release submission overview is aligned with the currently applicable submission policy and remains up to date.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 3 shows submission guidance, but screenshots cannot verify whether the rules match current policy or are up to date.

requirements.text: The system shall cover all major release submission rule categories from the overview page so contributors can discover every essential rule area from one starting point.
requirements.rationale: Broad category coverage is supported, while the universal completeness threshold remains unsettled.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall organize release submission guidance into linked topic areas so users can drill down into specific rule sets.

claims.claim: The overview page covers multiple release submission rule categories from one starting point.
claims.claim_text: The overview page covers multiple release submission rule categories from one starting point.

claims.claim: The overview page covers all major and every essential release submission rule area.
claims.claim_text: The overview page covers all major and every essential release submission rule area.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 3 shows a broad linked category list, but the screenshots do not establish completeness for all major or every essential release submission rule area.

requirements.text: The system shall provide an explicit transition from the release submission overview into the actual submission workflow so contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.
requirements.rationale: The relevant overview page is visible and lacks the required direct handoff into submission, creating visible counter-evidence for the core requirement.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall provide a clear separation between learning submission rules and performing a release submission.

claims.claim: The release submission overview provides an explicit transition into the actual submission workflow.
claims.claim_text: The release submission overview provides an explicit transition into the actual submission workflow.

claims.claim: Contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.
claims.claim_text: Contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.

claims.claim: A release submission action exists outside the release submission overview.
claims.claim_text: A release submission action exists outside the release submission overview.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 2 shows Submit a Release in the top-level contribution menu, but step 3's overview page does not show a direct transition or call-to-action into the submission workflow.

requirements.text: The system shall let authenticated contributors return directly from submission guidance pages to their submissions or drafts work areas without restarting from the main dashboard.
requirements.rationale: The guidance page is visible and lacks direct return paths to Submissions or Drafts, so the core observable requirement is contradicted.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall preserve access to broader site navigation while users are exploring contribution help resources.

claims.claim: Authenticated contributors can return directly from submission guidance pages to submissions work areas.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 1 shows Submissions and Drafts on the dashboard, but step 3's guidance page does not show direct return links to those work areas.
